The Chinese characters for Aurora

As a transliteration, Aurora is usually written 奥罗拉 (Ào luó lā). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Origin and meaning

With Latin origins, Aurora is usually read as “dawn”.

About the name Aurora

The Roman goddess of dawn, and the sleeping princess in the fairy tale.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “dawn”, an Aurora calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
